title: not stainless
text: not stainless. I've been using this for a couple of months, and it's definitely not stainless. Also, there are not enough to fit in all the stuff I need. It's a big brand and it does not match their reputation.

product_metadata.title: simplehuman Adjustable Shower Caddy, Stainless Steel and Anodized Aluminum
features: ADJUSTABLE SHELVES - Slide up, down and sideways to make room for taller bottles.
DESIGNED FOR MODERN TOOLS - Large modern shower accessories are hard to fit. Our innovative storage options are designed specifically with those tools in mind.
SOLID AND SECURE - Solid materials and secure installation give our caddies the feel of built-in fixtures.
QUICK ADJUST - Easily reposition shelves with a quick turn of the dial.
RUST-PROOF MATERIALS - Constructed from stainless steel and anodized aluminum.
QUICK-DRY SOAP DISH - Drains water completely so soap stays dry and lasts longer.
MOVEABLE DIVIDER - Helps keep small items from falling over (2 dividers shower caddy plus only).
EASY DISPENSING - Store bottles upside-down for effortless dispensing.
CONVENIENT STORAGE HOOKS - Hold a razor, loofah, or other accessories.
description: simplehuman's redesigned adjustable shower caddy is sleeker, neater and more secure. The shelves are fully adjustable and even easier to reposition with the new quick-adjust dial. We added a moveable divider to keep small items from falling over. And the quick-dry soap dish drains water completely so soap stays dry and lasts longer. Installation is secure and hassle-free with a rubberized showerhead clamp and twin pivoting suction cups. Constructed from stainless steel and anodized aluminum so it is rust-proof and easy to clean.

We design tools that help people become more efficient at home. Day to day life has room for improvement. That's the basic thinking behind simplehuman. Many activities in our daily routine are so basic that we take them for granted. Washing our hands, cleaning up after a meal, grooming and prepping our appearance. Through innovation and new technologies, we find ways to streamline these simple tasks. We call our products tools for efficient living.
